items.title: Tokenized Stock Trading Moves Closer to US Launch via OKX SEC Filing
items.description: The crypto exchange seeks regulatory clearance to bring blockchain-based equity products to American investors. OKX has filed paperwork with the US Securities and Exchange Commission, according to reports from CryptoBriefing and Coinfomania. The filing seeks approval to launch tokenized-stock trading for customers in the United States. The post Tokenized Stock Trading Moves Closer to US Launch via OKX SEC Filing appeared first on TheCoinrise.com .
